Andhra Pradesh to Promote Public Education

The government of Andhra Pradesh aims to improve public education by adopting best practices. The state's education minister, Lokesh, has called for a shift towards strengthening government schools and restoring their reputation. This effort is part of the government's strategy to promote public trust in government institutions.
